title: Navigation System Architecture Review & Roadmap
subtitle: Analysis of dogfood findings, L1/L2/L3 taxonomy unification, and mobile navigation contract

components.title: Wod.Wiki Navigation System Unification
components.body: Synthesis of the dogfood navigation audit (v0.48.2175) and architectural deep-module review. Establishes the Home/Pages roll-up, scopes Notebooks to subscribed libraries, scopes Notes to notebook members, enforces the mobile destination-versus-mutation invariant via a deep Navigation Shell, and outlines deployment-safe performance enhancements on GitHub Pages.

components.title: Dogfood Audit Findings & Structural Solutions
components.body: Detailed resolution matrix combining product feedback with deep architectural module patterns from architecture-review-20261027-124623.html.

components.title: Findings Resolution Matrix
components.body: Root causes and deep architectural solutions for each reported issue.
rows: Mobile drawer leaves full-screen overlay open on navigation
Medium
AppRail explicitly suppressed closeDrawer() on L1 clicks to 'keep drawer open for L2'. 7 callers guess when to close.
Deep Navigation Shell Module (Candidate 1): encapsulate drawer state behind navigateAction(item, { kind: 'destination' | 'mutation' }). Delete NavigationDrawerContext and MutationObserver.
All Sessions defaults to 'last 1d' query
Medium
SESSIONS_STREAM_PROFILE hardcodes defaultWql: ':session{} last 1d' while L1/L2 label reads 'All Sessions'.

StreamZone Registry Module (Candidate 2): unify stream profiles, WQL defaults, labels, and shortcuts into single definitions. Set Sessions default to ':session{}' (all-time); add 'Recent (1d)' shortcut.
Notes, Notebooks, and Pages heavily overlap
Medium
Three separate L1 routes query the same 280 seed notes without distinct conceptual boundaries.

Roll up Home and Pages: Home button opens navigation; Home pinned at top; 'All Pages' links to /pages with pinned Canvas/Guides below (with unpin support). Notebooks defaults to subscribed notebooks. Notes displays notebook-member notes.
Large eager startup payload & short cache TTL
Medium
CodeMirror and editor bundles preloaded in HTML; GitHub Pages serves static assets with max-age=600.

Vite dynamic imports (React.lazy) work natively on GitHub Pages with base path. Add a lightweight Service Worker for Cache-First handling of hashed /assets/*.js to overcome GitHub's 10-minute CDN TTL.
Duplicate Home and creation controls in viewport
Low
AppRail mounts avatar (Home) + dedicated Home icon; Efforts shows dual New buttons; Empty states duplicate CTAs.
Avatar acts as single Home affordance (opens navigation); remove redundant rail icon and consolidate duplicate in-viewport CTAs.
Mobile action-location setting mismatch
Low
Appearance setting describes floating bottom cluster, but actual UI renders actions in top header.
Prune dead setting copy; lock action placement to responsive header bar.

components.title: Deep Architecture Modules (from Architecture Review)
components.body: Addressing architectural debt identified in architecture-review-20261027-124623.html to support the navigation overhaul cleanly.

components.title: The Three Core Deep Modules
components.body: Replacing leaky coordination with high-leverage internal seams.

items.title: Navigation Shell Module
items.body: Collapses SidebarLayout drawer state, NavigationDrawerContext, and caller dismiss logic into one module. Callers invoke navigateAction(item, { kind }) where destination auto-closes and mutation retains the drawer. Internal occupancy tracking eliminates the DOM child MutationObserver.

items.title: StreamZone Registry Module
items.body: Folds streamProfile.ts, appNavTree.ts, and routeWqlShortcuts.ts into a single authoritative StreamZoneDefinition (route, title, defaultWql, shortcuts, icon, L1 metadata). Prevents query defaults from contradicting landing labels.

items.title: In-Page View Controller
items.body: Consolidates usePageScrollSync, useSectionScrollSpy, and disjoint L3 channels into a single registerViewSurface({ outline, controls, actions }) seam. Absorbs intersection observation and derives right-drawer presence internally.

components.title: The Mobile Contract: Navigation vs. Form Mutation
components.body: Resolving the core mobile dilemma: when to dismiss the full-screen drawer vs. when it must stick around.

components.title: Behavioral Distinction
components.body: Intent determines whether drawer auto-dismisses or requires explicit confirmation.

items.title: Navigation & Destination Jump
items.body: Triggered by: L1 icon click, L2 route/shortcut click, 'New note/effort' click, L3 TOC anchor click, or WQL search link. The URL changes or the page scrolls. The deep Navigation Shell immediately dismisses the drawer so the destination is visible without extra taps.

items.title: Query & View Configuration
items.body: Triggered by: L2 FacetProperties checkboxes (tags, status), L3 date window picker, group-by checkboxes, layout switchers, or visible field toggles. User is editing in-place settings and often toggles multiple values. The drawer stays open; the 'Apply' footer or backdrop dismisses it.

components.title: The Single Seam Rule
components.body: Instead of callers calling closeDrawer() directly, all navigation passes through navigateAction(item, { kind: 'destination' | 'mutation' }). Destination actions enforce drawer dismissal internally. Form option mutations retain drawer state until 'Apply' is pressed.

components.title: GitHub Pages Loading & Cache Strategy
components.body: Addressing Annotation 3: Ensuring code splitting and asset caching operate reliably within GitHub Pages constraints.

components.title: Deployment & Asset Pipeline
components.body: Technical mechanics for dynamic imports and caching on static GitHub Pages hosting.

items.title: React.lazy() Compatibility
items.body: Vite compiles dynamic imports to chunk URLs prefixed with the repository base (/wod-wiki/). GitHub Pages natively returns 200 OK for static .js asset requests. Direct route deep links utilize the existing 404.html SPA redirect shim.

items.title: Service Worker Cache-First
items.body: GitHub Pages enforces Cache-Control: max-age=600 at the edge. To achieve true immutable caching, register a lightweight Service Worker intercepting /assets/*-[hash].js with a Cache-First policy, providing instant cold boots after initial visit.

components.title: Implementation Roadmap & Next Steps
components.body: Phased delivery combining deep architectural refactors with immediate UX polish.

components.title: Execution Phases
components.body: Sequence of targeted PRs following test-driven delivery.

items.title: Navigation Shell Deep Module (Candidate 1)
items.body: Introduce navigateAction seam in Navigation Shell. Auto-dismiss drawers on destination clicks (L1 rail, L2 route/guide links, TOC anchors, WQL links). Retain drawers for facet and stream option mutations. Delete NavigationDrawerContext and MutationObserver DOM hack.

items.title: StreamZone Registry (Candidate 2) & Default Queries
items.body: Consolidate stream profiles, WQL defaults, labels, and shortcuts into unified StreamZone definitions. Fix Sessions default query to ':session{}' all-time; add 'Recent (1d)' shortcut. Remove duplicate Home icon and in-viewport CTAs.

items.title: Home/Pages Roll-Up & Scoped Libraries
items.body: Roll up Home and Pages: Home button opens navigation; Home pinned at top; 'All Pages' (/pages) list view with pinned Canvas/Guide documents below (with unpin support). Scope Notebooks to subscribed libraries by default. Scope Notes to notebook members.

items.title: Code-Splitting & Service Worker Caching
items.body: Lazy-load CodeMirror and heavy editor routes via React.lazy(). Implement Cache-First Service Worker for hashed static assets on GitHub Pages to bypass 10-minute edge revalidation.
